response.text:
I hear you, but I can't treat "send it now" as confirmation of the details — I need you to confirm the specifics, because this is a new payee and a large amount.

Please reply with exactly this (or a clear equivalent):

**"Yes, send AUD 2,000 to CityNest, account ending 4420."**

Then I'll add the payee and send it right away.
